title: Vantage x 12Labs: security review

sentences.speaker: Tom Alvarez
sentences.text: Thanks for joining. I'll be direct: we cannot onboard another vendor that sits outside our identity provider.

sentences.speaker: Dana Whitaker
sentences.text: Understood. Today our login is email and password with API keys.

sentences.speaker: Tom Alvarez
sentences.text: That is a non-starter. We need SAML single sign-on through Okta, with SCIM provisioning if possible.

sentences.speaker: Rachel Kim
sentences.text: And our auditors will ask for your SOC 2 Type II report, not just Type I.

sentences.speaker: Sam Ito
sentences.text: We have a Type I in hand. Type II observation window would finish this winter.

sentences.speaker: Tom Alvarez
sentences.text: Then put a date in the contract. January 31st works for us; if it slips we pause the expansion.

sentences.speaker: Dana Whitaker
sentences.text: I will take that back and confirm the date in writing this week.

sentences.speaker: Rachel Kim
sentences.text: The expansion is worth about three hundred thousand, so this matters to us as much as to you.

summary: Vantage will only expand if 12Labs delivers SAML SSO and a SOC 2 Type II report by 31 January 2027. CISO considers email/password login a non-starter.
action_items: Dana to confirm 31 Jan 2027 date in writing
Sam to share SOC 2 Type I and audit window timeline
